summary.zh: opinion-manager 的 lifecycle 支持 Profile schema 2.2 的标签记账：use 事件新增 loaded_tags 与 routing_miss_tags，取值校验自 loading.tags；有标签漏读的使用与规则束漏读一样阻断转正式；status 对标签输出 loaded_in、exercised_in、routing_misses 与 unused_tags。2.1 的 loaded_bundles、routing_miss、bundles 输出不变。
summary.en: opinion-manager lifecycle now records tags for Profile schema 2.2: use events gain loaded_tags and routing_miss_tags, validated against loading.tags; a use with a missed tag blocks formalization just like a missed bundle; status reports loaded_in, exercised_in, routing_misses and unused_tags per tag. The 2.1 loaded_bundles, routing_miss and bundles output are unchanged.
